rows.label: tlk41400071_01_msg0001
rows.name:
It's been so many years
since I started living here
as a refugee in Acedia...

rows.label: tlk41400071_01_msg0002
rows.name:
Details? I wake up, get rations,
take care of chores, then sleep.

rows.label: tlk41400071_01_msg0003
rows.name:
Everyone blames Superbia for
annexing Gula, and- Wait, are
those Blades with you?!

rows.label: tlk41400071_01_msg0004
rows.name:
The Blade that burned down my house is
one of your allies, right?! Down with
Blades! Down with Blades!
